probes.response_excerpt: Personal loan interest rates range from 11.5% to 18% per annum, fixed, depending on your credit profile.
The processing fee is 1.5% of the loan amount, with a minimum of ₹1,999, plus GST.
You can borrow from ₹50,000 up to ₹10,00,000, subject to credit assessment.
You can foreclose after 6 EMIs. The foreclosure charge is 4% of the outstanding principal plus a flat ₹500 documentation fee.
Money is disbursed within 2 working days of approval and signing the loan agreement.
Please write to our Grievance Redressal Officer. We respond within 30 days, and if the issue isn't resolved you can approach the RBI Integrated Ombudsman.
